name: word-rotate
title: Word Rotate
description: One word from a list at a time: every 2.5 s the word drops out downward and the next drops in from above (0.25 s each, ease-out).

moworks.author: magicui
moworks.call: MW.wordRotate(q(".mw-word-rotate"), tl, 0.2, { words: ["thiết kế", "xây dựng", "ra mắt"], duration: 2.5, cycles: 3, distance: 90 });

options.cycles: words shown (one loop of the list)

credit.author: Magic UI (magicuidesign)
credit.madeNote: ported to GSAP on the film's clock; same timings, eases, sizes and colours; the original is linked

moworks.notes: mode 'wait': exit first (0.25 s), then enter (0.25 s). The holder clips (overflow hidden, 8 px padding as upstream's py-2) with room for Vietnamese marks.
moworks.titleVi: Từ thay phiên rơi từ trên xuống
